name: How long does an AI SEO website audit typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI SEO website audit typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an AI SEO website audit varies based on the size and complexity of your website. For smaller sites, it might take 1-2 weeks. Larger e-commerce platforms or enterprise-level sites with extensive content could require 3-4 weeks or more for a thorough analysis. This includes data collection, analysis, and the compilation of a detailed report with actionable recommendations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration of an AI SEO website audit depends on website size, typically ranging from 1-2 weeks for small sites to 3-4 weeks for larger ones.
